description: Complete trace of project-scoped template filtering implementation showing current state, desired state, and gaps to close for 100% multi-tenant isolation compliance

content.overview: Complete multi-tenant isolation by implementing project-scoped template filtering. Currently supports global and org-scoped templates. This adds the final layer: project-level isolation within organizations.

components.currentBehavior: Filters templates by scope: (scope=NULL OR scope='global') for unauthenticated, (scope=NULL OR scope='global' OR (scope='org' AND org_id=$org_id)) for authenticated users. Line 106 has TODO comment about project-scoped filtering.
components.desiredBehavior: Should filter: (scope=NULL OR scope='global') OR (scope='org' AND org_id=$org_id) OR (scope='project' AND project_id=$project_id). Requires project_id parameter extracted from user authentication context.
components.gap: Missing project_id parameter in function signature and SurrealDB query WHERE clause. Need to add: 'OR (scope="project" AND project_id = $project_id)' to query lines 126 and 138.

components.currentBehavior: Filters templates by org_id and scope. Lines 186-189 explicitly skip project-scoped templates with TODO comment. Calls list_all_templates(limit, org_id).
components.desiredBehavior: Should pass project_id to list_all_templates() and remove the project-scope skip logic (lines 185-188). Templates with scope='project' should be included if user's project_id matches.
components.gap: Missing project_id parameter in list_templates function signature and list_all_templates call. Remove filtering logic that skips project-scoped templates.

components.currentBehavior: Extracts org_id from Bearer token (lines 105-114) using session_id_from_token helper. Passes org_id to list_templates(). No project_id extraction.
components.desiredBehavior: Should extract both org_id AND project_id from Bearer token authentication context. Pass both to list_templates(redis, category, limit, org_id, project_id).
components.gap: Missing project_id extraction from authentication token. Need to decode/lookup session data to get project_id field.

components.currentBehavior: Extracts org_id from Bearer token (lines 234-248). Creates template with scope (default='org') and org_id. No project_id support.
components.desiredBehavior: Should extract project_id from Bearer token when scope='project'. Store project_id in template record alongside scope and org_id.
components.gap: Missing project_id extraction and parameter passing to create_template(). Need to add project_id to create_template function signature.

components.currentBehavior: Accepts scope and org_id parameters (line 304-305). Stores them in template record (lines 386-387). No project_id field.
components.desiredBehavior: Should accept project_id parameter and store it in template record when scope='project'. Template object should include 'project_id': project_id field.
components.gap: Missing project_id parameter in function signature and template object construction.

components.currentBehavior: Contains session_id. Used as placeholder for org_id (lines 112-114 in routes/activity.py).
components.desiredBehavior: Should include org_id and project_id fields in SessionData model. Bearer tokens should contain full authentication context.
components.gap: SessionData model likely missing org_id and project_id fields. Need to extend model and populate from authentication system.

components.currentBehavior: Decodes base64 Bearer token to extract session_id. Returns session_id as string.
components.desiredBehavior: Should be extended to fetch full SessionData including org_id and project_id from session storage. Or provide helper functions get_org_id_from_token() and get_project_id_from_token().
components.gap: Only returns session_id. Need to fetch and return full session context with org_id and project_id.

components.currentBehavior: Tests org-scoped template creation and filtering. Validates scope='org' and org_id extraction from Bearer token.
components.desiredBehavior: Should include test cases for project-scoped templates: (1) Create template with scope='project' and project_id, (2) Verify User 1 (Project A) can see template, (3) Verify User 2 (Project B, same org) CANNOT see template, (4) Verify User 3 (different org) CANNOT see template.
components.gap: Missing project-scope test cases. Need to add testProjectScopeIsolationWithinOrg() and testProjectScopeIsolationAcrossOrgs().

dataFlow.authExtraction: Bearer token → session_id_from_token() → SessionData lookup → extract org_id + project_id
dataFlow.templateCreation: create_activity_template() → extract scope, org_id, project_id → create_template(redis, template_data, scope, org_id, project_id) → SurrealDB write with scope/org_id/project_id fields
dataFlow.templateQuery: list_activity_templates() → extract org_id, project_id → list_templates(redis, category, limit, org_id, project_id) → list_all_templates(limit, org_id, project_id) → SurrealDB query with WHERE clause filtering by scope/org_id/project_id
dataFlow.validation: Validation harness creates templates with different scopes, queries as different users, verifies isolation
